text: My main symptom is Recurrent episodes of stridor and wheezing. I also have Exacerbation during crying, Exacerbation during feeding, Exacerbation with neck flexion, Relief with neck extension, Occasional vomiting post-feeding.

speaker: Doctor
text: The positional nature of the symptoms and the normal laryngoscopy strongly suggest vascular compression of the airway, likely a vascular ring. REQUEST TEST: CT_angiography_of_chest_and_neck

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: CT angiography confirms a double aortic arch with the right arch anterior and the left arch posterior, encircling the trachea and esophagus. Significant compression of the trachea is observed, correlating with the clinical symptoms of stridor and wheezing.

speaker: Doctor
text: The CT angiography confirms the diagnosis of a double aortic arch causing significant tracheal compression. DIAGNOSIS READY: Double aortic arch
